name: select
title: Select
description: A native select whose option list is drawn in the same material.
use: One value from a list of plain text options, when the list is too long to show whole or space is tight. The browser keeps the keys, type-ahead and the form value.

instead.when: The list is long and the reader finds a value by typing
There are two to five short options that fit in one row
Every option should stay visible, a row each
The options need icons, descriptions or filtering by a script

keyboard.action: Open the list or move through its options, as the native select does
Moves to the option that starts with the typed letters

platform.fallback: The select keeps its well and chevron and opens the platform's own option list; select-option has no effect

classes.name: select
classes.description: A native select drawn as a well with a chevron

classes.name: select-option
classes.description: An option in the customizable list: a row that takes a chip tone under the pointer or the keys, with a check on the current one

classes.name: select-raised
classes.description: A raised select for toolbars and filter rows, beside buttons; 38px tall unless a size is set

classes.name: select-sm
classes.description: 32px tall; the default is 38px, a button's height

classes.name: select-lg
classes.description: 44px tall; the default is 38px, a button's height

states.name: open
states.description: The select keeps its focused face and, in the customizable select, the chevron turns over

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink; a raised select drops to a flat well

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink, and no tone under the pointer

example:
<label class="field">
  Framework
  <select class="select">
    <option class="select-option">Astro</option>
    <option class="select-option">Next.js</option>
    <option class="select-option">SvelteKit</option>
  </select>
</label>
